value.rationale: A natural exact dichotomy is proved for the entire class of finite simple graphs: cacti are precisely those for which adaptive orientation prediction has the same combinatorial dimension as nonadaptive VC shattering. The complementary theta obstruction yields a uniform rank-plus-one bound and an unbounded dimension gap on disjoint diamonds. This is a general structural property with concrete infinite-family consequences, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a small numerical improvement.
